newsitem.title: DUBAI: Shares rise on active Saudi stock market in week.
newsitem.headline: Shares rise on active Saudi stock market in week.

text.p: Share prices rose on a more active Saudi Arabian stock exchange last week, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The index was up at 138.95 points in the week to Thursday from 137.01 points a week earlier.
Volume almost doubled to 5.14 million shares from 2.78 million shares a week earlier. The value of shares traded rose to 655.58 million riyals ($174.8 million) from 395.67 million riyals, BFA said.
Services sector shares dominated trade, accounting for 66 percent of total volume. Cement shares followed, with 13 percent of turnover.
BFA said 55 companies were traded in the week. Share prices of 21 rose, 21 dropped and the rest were unchanged.
Saudi American Bank was the biggest gainer in the week with its share price up 6.7 percent at 462 riyals.
With 1.08 million shares traded, Mobarrad was the most active share by volume, accounting for over 21 percent of total turnover, BFA said.
Mobarrad shares slipped two riyals from the start of the week's trade to 70 riyals.

Other active shares included Arriyadh Development, which accounted for about 20 percent of shares traded with some 1.03 million shares changing hands. It closed at 69 riyals on Thursday from 72 riyals at the start of the week's trade. ($1=3.75 riyals)
